cloudflarer

cloudflarer is an R wrapper around the Cloudflare REST API (v4). It provides authenticated request helpers, response unwrapping, paginated list collectors, and a generic cf_request() function so you can call any endpoint, including ones the package does not wrap yet.

Installation

Install the development version from GitHub:

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("drmowinckels/cloudflarer")

Authentication

cloudflarer supports both Cloudflare credential schemes:

  • API token (recommended) – created at https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens, scoped to the resources and verbs your script needs.
  • Global API Key (legacy) – the unscoped account-wide key, paired with the account email.

Set whichever you prefer in ~/.Renviron:

# API token (recommended)
CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=your-token-here

# OR Global API Key (legacy)
CLOUDFLARE_EMAIL=you@example.com
CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY=your-global-api-key

Restart R and check the connection:

library(cloudflarer)
cf_sitrep()

See vignette("authentication", package = "cloudflarer") for the full walkthrough.

Usage 

library(cloudflarer)

cf_user()
cf_list_accounts()
cf_list_zones()
cf_list_dns_records(zone_id = "abc123")

Calling endpoints that are not wrapped yet

Every endpoint in the Cloudflare API reference is reachable through the generic cf_request() helper. It handles authentication, unwraps the {success, errors, result, ...} envelope, and raises a classed cloudflarer_error for failures.

cf_request("user/tokens/verify")

cf_request(
  "zones/abc123/dns_records",
  method = "POST",
  body = list(
    type    = "A",
    name    = "www.example.com",
    content = "192.0.2.1",
    ttl     = 1,
    proxied = TRUE
  )
)

For paginated list endpoints, use cf_request_collect():

cf_request_collect("accounts", per_page = 50)
